purpose: Machine-consumed Short-only regression floor derived from the fixed independent-viewer review of Run #228. It must never govern Long releases and is not a human-MOS conversion or target style.

human_observation.reason: The historical 6.5-7.0 score was a human qualitative observation and must not be converted into a deterministic engineering score.

long_policy.required_future_design: long-specific benchmark set with range-based calibration
long_policy.section_policy: evaluate sections in narrative context; never treat every section as an independent Short
